about: Every key in the Firefox schemas, by context. consumed: the generator reads it and output depends on it, at every position that carries it except those an unread group names with a reason. declined: ignored on purpose, reason required, firefox names the Firefox file when the reason is Firefox behavior. unresolved: a new or newly unread pair nobody has decided, npm test fails until it is consumed or declined. Regenerate statuses with npm run ledger:update, check with npm test and npm run ablate.
